Contemporary Food - Farm-to-Table, Fermentation Revival, and Lab-Grown Meat

sections.text: Contemporary food culture is a reaction to industrialization. After a century of homogenization, chemical additives, ultra-processing, and supply chain abstraction, a counter-movement is underway simultaneously in kitchens, restaurants, farms, and laboratories. The tension is between industrial efficiency (feed 8 billion people) and quality, ecology, and health. Both imperatives are real and neither wins cleanly.
